message.content:
The Declaration of Independence was signed by 56 delegates representing the thirteen colonies. Some of the most well‑known signers include:

| Signer | Colony / State |
|--------|----------------|
| John Hancock | Massachusetts |
| Benjamin Franklin | Pennsylvania |
| Samuel Adams | Massachusetts |
| George Washington | Virginia |
| Thomas Jefferson | Virginia |
| John Jay | New York |
| John Adams | Massachusetts |
| Patrick Henry | Virginia |
| Roger Sherman | Connecticut |
| William Ellery | Rhode Island |

(For a complete list, you can refer to official records or reputable history sources.)

There's no need to call the tool because it's not about retrieving a date. But we could use the tool if they wanted the date of signing. But question: "Who signed the declaration of independence?" It's a straightforward request. Provide the names. Probably mention the main signers: Thomas Jefferson wrote it, but signers include John Hancock, Benjamin Franklin, etc. Provide a list.

We should respond with the list. No tool needed.
